summary.zh: 分子证据显示木贼类嵌套在蕨类之中，二者合称真蕨类（monilophytes），是种子植物的姐妹群。
summary.en: Molecular data nest horsetails inside the ferns; together they form the monilophytes, sister to seed plants.

synapomorphies.zh: 依靠孢子繁殖，叶多为羽状

debate.zh: 传统上木贼被单独列为木贼纲；分子系统发育推翻了这一做法。
debate.en: Horsetails were traditionally a separate class; molecular phylogenies overturned that.
